title: f1-1/f1-4 color core — di/dwg node reference, opendrt cpu

commit.merge_subject: merge: f1-1/f1-4 color core — di/dwg node reference, opendrt cpu

description:
F1-4 of the color model v2 plan. core/src/OpenDrt.cpp is a line-by-line
port of Klipp's Kotlin port (engine/OpenDrt.kt) of OpenDRT.dctl v1.1.0:
the look/tonescale preset tables and the matrices were converted from
the Kotlin source by script (no retyping), the algorithm keeps the
Kotlin operation order so the GLSL pass can be held to the same
numbers. Input is DWG linear (NodesOutput::DwgLinear); displays are
sRGB 2.2, Rec.1886 2.4 and HLG 1000 as a float signal. PQ is out of
scope (K7). 10-bit quantisation stays with E1d/E2.

Reference vectors: core/tests/data/opendrt_klipp_*.txt are verbatim
subsets (S-Log3 and DI input rows, 768 SDR + 384 HLG) of Klipp's test
resources. Klipp states they are OpenDRT.dctl output; this repo has
not regenerated or verified that, so the tests prove equivalence with
Klipp's data, not with the DCTL. Measured worst deviation: 6.6e-7 SDR,
